meta.description:
A guided meditation on the moment someone goes beyond what you predicted of them. You are invited to hold your guess lightly, set it beside the person, and listen.

A guided meditation for minds that predict well, resting attention on a moment someone surprised you and was more than your guess.

copy.hook: You can guess what someone will say, what they'll worry about, how they'll answer. What if the part that is them is the part you couldn't guess?
copy.lead: A guided meditation on the moment someone goes beyond what you predicted of them. You are invited to hold your guess lightly, set it beside the person, and listen.
copy.alt: A dark indigo space where a single gold ring ripples among thin teal outlines, then a pale lattice sketch bent by a glowing aurora, and finally a small wireframe resting beside a soft, luminous form on a still dusk sea.
